'''Giuseppe Da Prato''' (23 July 1936 – 6 October 2023) was an Italian academic and mathematician.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=6 October 2023|title=È morto Giuseppe Da Prato, fu professore all'Università di Trento|trans-title= |url=https://www.trentotoday.it/cronaca/giuseppe-da-prato.html|language=Italian|work=TrentoToday|location= |access-date=7 October 2023}}</ref> He taught at the [[Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa]]. He mainly researched [[stochastic calculus]], [[partial differential equation|partial differential equations]], and [[control theory]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Da_Prato_Giuseppe|title=Giuseppe Da Prato|work=Academia Europaea}}</ref>

==Biography==
Born in [[La Spezia]] on 23 July 1936, Da Prato earned his doctorate at the [[Sapienza University of Rome]] in 1960 under the direction of {{ill|Marcello Cini|it}}. In 1963, he became an assistant professor at the [[University of Pisa]]. He became a professor at the Sapienza in 1968 and won the [[Bartolozzi Prize]] the following year. He remained at the Sapienza until 1977, during which time he was also a guest professor at the [[Université Nice-Sophia-Antipolis]] in France.{{cn|date=May 2024}} He worked at the [[University of Trento]] from 1977 to 1979, and subsequently joined the Scuola Normale Superiore, where he stayed for nearly 30 years. He was also a guest professor at the [[University of Maryland, College Park]] in the United States from 1981 to 1982.{{cn|date=May 2024}}

Da Prato served on the editorial board of numerous mathematical journals. He also co-founded the journal Nonlinear Differential Equations and Applications.

Giuseppe Da Prato died on 6 October 2023, at the age of 87.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=6 October 2023|title=Addio al matematico Giuseppe Da Prato, professore emerito della Classe di Scienze|trans-title= |url=https://normalenews.sns.it/addio-al-matematico-giuseppe-da-prato-professore-emerito-della-classe-di-scienze|language=Italian|work=[[Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa]]|location= |access-date=7 October 2023}}</ref>
